name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: Content scrolls continuously along a track without interaction. Logo strips and social proof.
docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

configurables.what: CSS-mode scroll speed used to derive animation duration from content width.
configurables.how: 75 for logo bars; 40–60 for dense text; 100–150 for punchy hero strips. Default: 75. Ignored when draggable.
true for opposing dual marquees. Default: false.
true when items are links users must click. Default: false.

configurables.what: Edge fade masks on the track.
configurables.how: true for polished marketing; false when the track is full-bleed. Default: true.

configurables.what: Switches to GSAP draggable marquee contract instead of CSS loop.
configurables.how: true only when the animations package + data-draggable-marquee hooks are installed. Default: false.
15–25 for logos; higher = slower. Source default is 20 when draggable. Only when draggable.
30–40 default feel; lower for tighter control. Default: 35. Only when draggable.
0.01 default; raise slightly for touch-first UIs. Default: 0.01. Only when draggable.

gotchas.note: CSS mode duplicates children for seamless loop. Wrap each logo/line in MarqueeItem; use MarqueeSeparator between marks.
Duplicated list is aria-hidden; keep meaningful text in the first list only. Prefer pauseOnHover when content is interactive.
draggable requires the motion package hooks that read data-draggable-marquee attributes — without them the track will not move.

agent.usage:
import { Marquee, MarqueeItem, MarqueeSeparator } from '@/components/atoms/Marquee';

<Marquee speed={75} fade pauseOnHover>
  <MarqueeItem>Acme</MarqueeItem>
  <MarqueeSeparator />
  <MarqueeItem>Globex</MarqueeItem>
</Marquee>
